question.text: A series LCR circuit is designed to resonate at an angular frequency <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>ω</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>5</mn></msup><mo> </mo><mi>rad</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> The circuit draws <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>16</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi></math> power from <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>120</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> source at resonance. The value of resistance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi></math> in the circuit is ________ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi><mo>.</mo></math>
